about_the_game:
Team up with Ken’s aunt, Lady Carson, and the Park Rangers to give the already amazing park a fresh new look, turning it into a space for everyone to enjoy! Hop on your horse and gallop through fields of wildflowers, explore lush forests, climb breathtaking mountains, or take a relaxing stroll by a sparkling lake.






From the cozy cabins to the lively campsite, you’ll meet friends like Ken, Teresa, Nikki, and Daisy for fun side missions. Bond with Lucky by cleaning, grooming, and feeding her. Uncover fascinating animals and plants at the Wildlife Centre.






As a Junior Ranger-in-Training, you’ll learn all you need to know about the park with Head Ranger, Annalise. Join Archaeologist, Dr. Potts, as you dig up ceramics and find the mystery horse. Ride through the wilderness, capturing incredible moments with your camera and saving your discoveries in your journal to showcase the park’s beauty.



On your quests, you’ll find chests filled with collectibles. Show off your creativity, styling Barbie and Barbie to match every adventure. Add more sparkle to Lucky, accessorizing her with bridles, saddles, colourful braids, ribbons, and clips.



There is plenty to unlock and discover. Ride along on this wild adventure and see!


CARE FOR HORSES: Groom and accessorize your horse, Lucky, as you build a memorable friendship with her.

PLAY AS BARBIE: Take the reins as Barbie ‘Brooklyn’ Roberts or Barbie ‘Malibu’ Roberts.

EXPLORE THE OPEN-WORLD: Walk, trot, or gallop with Lucky and discover the park’s beauty.

TRAIN AS A JUNIOR RANGER: Learn how to care for Canterbury Trails Park with help from nature experts.

CAPTURE WILDLIFE MOMENTS: Use your camera to take photos of animals, plants and other discoveries then save them in your journal to help you on your quests.

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2500X / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
